name: Lumenswap
description: Lumenswap is a production-grade decentralized exchange built natively on the Stellar network. It leverages Stellar's AMM and order book capabilities to provide fast, low-cost asset trading. Users can swap assets using pathfinding, place limit orders on a distributed order book, and provide liquidity to earn fees. Lumenswap integrates with common Stellar wallets (Freighter, Rabet, Albedo), indexes Horizon data for fast quotes, and uses Stellar transaction building/signing to execute trades atomically on mainnet. Its low fees and ~5s confirmations make it accessible for wide adoption.
tags: stellar, defi, dex, trading, amm, orderbook, fintech, mainnet
